Shipping page: ships worldwide incl. US (Zone 6, rate table shows 21,9 €, calculated at checkout), CA, AU, GB. Free-shipping promotions ($400) exclude the US. Orders dispatched in 2-3 working days; sales add 2-3 days.
Returns (How To Return): 30 days from delivery; free with the prepaid label; orders outside UK/EU must request a return form; earrings, socks, swimwear and underwear can't be returned unless faulty.
Store list: US stores at 14 E. 55th Street New York, 8320 Melrose Avenue Los Angeles, and an outlet at 2501 Hempstead Turnpike (Belmont, NY).

Size filters: dresses XS–XL, UK 6–16, IT 36–48; rings XXS–XXL. Wikipedia: operating company Vivienne Westwood Ltd, original shop 430 Kings Road London; orb logo from the 1987/88 Harris Tweed collection; credited with bringing punk into the mainstream.
